content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital product

The infrastructure built by COREMERCH allows digital creators to establish their own online stores free from reliance on conventional payment processors. This is particularly significant in regions where services like Stripe and PayPal are either unavailable or impose restrictive KYC requirements. By leveraging a stack that combines GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend processing, and NOWPayments for seamless crypto transactions, creators can operate their businesses independently. This architecture is essential for anyone looking to engage in digital commerce without the constraints that traditional systems impose.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a COREMERCH stack is designed for efficiency and independence. Using platforms such as GitHub Pages for hosting ensures minimal costs, while Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, allowing for automated delivery of digital products. Orders are stored securely using options like Supabase or Google Sheets, providing easy access and management. NOWPayments facilitates instant crypto payment processing, converting the payment to USD at the time of transaction. This setup is not just a workaround; it's a robust, sovereign solution that places control firmly in the hands of the creator, enabling them to bypass the fees and restrictions associated with traditional platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

COREMERCH's infrastructure is specifically crafted for digital creators in regions where conventional payment gateways fail. This includes authors selling ebooks, educators offering online courses, designers distributing templates and fonts, and musicians sharing beats. These individuals have faced barriers due to geographical restrictions or high transaction fees. With a solution that charges just 0.5% for payment processing through NOWPayments as opposed to the 10% charged by platforms like Gumroad, creators can significantly increase their profit margins. This infrastructure empowers them to operate without the overhead and constraints imposed by traditional payment systems.
Retain 100% ownership of your digital sales process.
The Components That Make It Work Together

At the core of the COREMERCH offering are several key components that work harmoniously to create an efficient digital commerce stack. Hosting is provided through GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, ensuring reliability and cost-effectiveness. The backend is powered by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which automate order processing and product delivery. For data management, Supabase or Google Sheets store order information securely. Finally, NOWPayments enables automatic crypto payment processing, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and charges only a 0.5% fee. This integration of components ensures creators have a streamlined, fully functional digital product store without depending on third-party platforms.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To begin deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack, first, acquire the Complete Builder Kit for $197, which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates necessary for setup. Next, choose your hosting solution—GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—and follow the provided documentation to set up your store. Configure your backend logic with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, ensuring seamless order fulfillment. Store your product information securely using Supabase or Google Sheets. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to start accepting cryptocurrency payments. This straightforward approach allows you to establish a fully operational digital product store in a matter of hours.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a sovereign digital commerce stack like that offered by COREMERCH. This solution allows you to handle payments through cryptocurrencies via NOWPayments, eliminating the need for traditional payment processors. As a result, you retain full ownership and control over your sales.
